title: Round 8 stream C: THE DOME CITY, a second layout of the base (?base=dome|classic): six domes and four bridges round the Stalheart, the classic islands moved between them by a placement table, the default flipped to dome
context: Owner, 2026-11-05, round 8 notes 5 and 6 (spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-06-round-8-seven-notes-design.md, stream C): 'we import new models: dome-city, ...' and 'we introduce a new layout for the main base: the dome city, which includes our existing elements in between'. The author's city (SentryTowers_A6 assets/dome-city/layout.json at 40c23fa4, kept in the vault) is nine domes on an 80 m grid, twelve 52 m bridges, four courts, status diorama_candidate_not_game_integration. Branch round-8-dome off d67d5fb7, worktree ~/Dev/stalheart-r8-dome, port 18183, nothing pushed. The owner was asleep: every reading below is the agent's, written down so one line overturns it.
outcome: THE READING: six domes and four bridges. The Stalheart is the power dome (DOME_22 not placed); DOME_12 (research, north centre) gives way to the mouth corridor, the landing and the sightline; DOME_32 (south centre) to the bays and the hull's roll-out; so the two outer columns stand (dome-nw habitat (-80,-80), dome-w biosphere (-80,0), dome-sw habitat (-80,80), dome-ne logistics (80,-80), dome-e fabrication (80,0), dome-se logistics (80,80)) with their four north-south bridges (bridge-w1/w2/e1/e2 at (+-80, +-40), the author's yaw -pi/2 = heading [-1,0]). Content in src/content/dome-city.js (DOME_ISLANDS 30 x 30, DOME_STRUCTURES LOD1 near / LOD2 far, the linked PORT_CAP_N / PORT_CAP_S hidden by name, DOME_PLACEMENT, DOME_SOLIDS); the pure withBaseLayout(islands, structures, mode) and baseLayoutMode(search) beside withLandmarkTiers / landmarkTierMode in src/content/base-layout.js, the one place a layout becomes the arrays, used by story-world (storyLayout, padOf off the layout's islands), td-tab (storyQuery.base) and the three labs. planBase (src/domain/base-plan.js) gains `founded` (never pending: stage 2, standing from a grown base's first frame because no step prints it; a plain stage still places it at its own stage, so the stage-1 list is unchanged) and `anchor: 'frame'` (a structure at its own x, z, no island). NO SLAB UNDER A BRIDGE: its ends stand inside the domes' plots (26 m of 40), so a bridge island cannot keep 4 m; 40 m out the dome stands 1.06 m lower and tilted 0.053 rad, its port 0.33 m below the bridge's socket (R 753.3), so lift -0.33 puts the deck on both ports and the end columns on the domes' slabs to the centimetre. THE PLACEMENT (measured with a plan print, 2 m a character, and test/dome-city.mjs): stays the Stalheart, landing, bays, HUGIN (5.8 m from bridge-w1's strip, 5 m from dome-nw's plot), boards, radar, armory, garage, solar, farm; the launcher's classic plot is dome-w's, so it goes north of HUGIN at (-50,-92) turned to fire -Z over the north rim (its 46 m rail now along its 30 m plot, the breech 3.8 m short of HUGIN's slab, 8.8 m from dome-nw, nothing of the city ahead of the payload); the assembly line runs 1 m into dome-e at (56,6) and at the design's x 50 its ammunition dump (16-21 m west of its centre) lands on the Stalheart's slab (-1.8 m, the rails -4.4/-8.5 m box to box), so it SWAPS with the chip plant: assembly (60,40) in the cargo court (11.4 m from dome-e and dome-se), chips (50,6) beside the Stalheart; stream D's depot (36 x 16) gets (42,-86) in the NE court north of the solar array, about 80 m from the gate at (0,-155); the table skips ids the tree has not got (tested). The domes and bridges join SOLID_STRUCTURES (a dome's shell meets the ground all round; a bridge stops the hull at its columns, the 19 m opening and the deck's 7.5 m underside let it under). The terminal: DOME CITY in the colony section, its stage the habitat LOD2, on the books on the base that has it (a `base` need in unitState). docs/ASSETS.md and ATTRIBUTIONS.md rows for the Dome Colony (research and power pinned, not placed). THE FRAME (--dome-look, headless Chrome on this machine, the median of 12 perf samples): from above, everything in the frame, classic 3,426 calls / 2.70 M triangles / 21.7 ms (gpu 20.9), dome 3,466 / 2.77 M / 22.5 ms (gpu 21.6): the city at its far tier costs +40 calls, +72k triangles, +0.8 ms. On the base camera a skipped opening starts on, classic 3,140 / 3.30 M / 23.9 ms, dome 1,896 / 3.17 M / 22.5 ms: the drop is the assembly line leaving the frame (it moved behind the camera into the cargo court), not the domes, four domes and all four bridges at their near tier in that frame. THE CAMERA: the chase eye rides 27.7 m behind and 34.2 m up; with the hull set down 22 m out of each dome facing away (the worst case) it never enters a glass shell (13.2 m high), it stands over the dome at its sentry platform's height, 2.2 to 10.9 m from the 2.2 m mast (dome-w 2.2 m and dome-se 2.8 m: in the cradle, the mast fills the frame); no clip against structures exists, a follow-up. THE SUITES on ?base=dome (one chain under the lock, BASE=dome): --story-world (31 steps), --colony, --companions, --board, --opening, --sector-probe, --canyon, --descent, --laser-game green; --gunship red at the seat's program count (110 -> 123, four named programs BASE_KIT_GAME / Skirt / Slab / BackgroundCubeMaterial at an srgb output), red the same way on ?base=classic (106 -> 119, the same four), so not the city's. THE DEFAULT IS DOME: the flip is the stream's last commit; ?base=classic always stays. Left undone by design: the domes' sentry cradles (MOUNT_YAW / CRADLE_PITCH engine pivots, a Railgun on four corner domes upstream), the camera's clip against structures, the swarm's bodies are not stopped by the domes (they walk the lattice, the domes stop the hull only; neither door's road to the Stalheart passes a dome).
alternatives: All nine domes and twelve bridges as authored: overturned; the centre column's three domes stand on the Stalheart, the landing / mouth corridor and the bays.

A slab island under each bridge (56 x 8): overturned; a bridge's ends lie inside its domes' plots, so the island rule (4 m) cannot hold, and the sphere's drop is met by lift -0.33 at the ports and the domes' own slabs under the end columns.

The assembly line at x 50 (the design's first guess): overturned by the measurement; its ammunition dump lay on the Stalheart's slab and rails. The swap with the chip plant keeps every island's structures unchanged.

The launcher west in the SW court over bridge-w2 (radar and armory moved) or at z -40 with HUGIN moved north: overturned; both move two or three islands, the north court moves one and the payload has open sky ahead.
Domes and bridges at stage 1 so a grown base has them: overturned; it changes the stage-1 list and the bare-landing assertion; `founded` keeps the plain plans byte for byte.
Leave dome opt-in: the chain is green on dome but for --gunship, which is red identically on classic, so the spec's rule flips it.
evidence: test/dome-city.mjs (new): the parser, classic identity, only centres move, unknown ids skipped and the depot stood in, the author's coordinates and modules, each bridge between two domes 80 m apart with exactly the linked caps hidden (by node name in the LOD1 file), islands 4 m apart and inside the clearing, none under a bridge strip, every model box 2 m from the city and off other islands' slabs, the sightline free, the launcher's payload clears the city, a 2 m flood from the bays reaches every island, the mouth and the courts, the bridges and domes standing at stage 1 of a grown plan; mutation-checked (no launcher move, assembly at x 50, the launcher firing west each fail)
